newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinians clash with Israeli soldiers.
newsitem.headline: Palestinians clash with Israeli soldiers.

text.p: Stone-throwing Palestinian protesters fought Israeli soldiers in the West Bank on Thursday, the eighth day of demonstrations over new Israeli settlement construction in East Jersualem, witnesses said.
They said about 200 youths marching from the PLO-ruled town of Ramallah hurled stones at soldiers and blocked the main Jerusalem-Ramallah road with burning tyres and the hulks of two abandoned cars.
Smoke billowed overhead as Israeli soldiers fired tear gas and rubber bullets to disperse the demonstrators, who fanned out over the hills overlooking the road.
There were no reports of injuries.
An Israeli army spokesman confirmed that Palestinian youths had gathered near Ramallah and said he was checking the details of the clashes.

Last week Israel touched off Palestinian demonstrations by sending bulldozers to work on building 6,500 housing units for Jews on a pine-studded hill called Jabal Abu Ghneim by Palestinians and Har Homa by Israelis.

About 25 Palestinians were hurt by rubber bullets or were overcome by tear gas during clashes on Wednesday. In contrast to bloody confrontations last September, Israeli security forces have avoided using live ammunition against demonstrators.
Palestinians clashed with Israelis near the West bank town of Bir Zeit and on the main road between Ramallah and Jerusalem on Thursday morning. There were no reports of injuries.
